skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with a 4-hit combo, dealing 45% ATK DMG per hit.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with a 4-hit combo, dealing 50% ATK DMG per hit.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally acts, has a 20% chance to launch a Follow-up against the enemy with the lowest HP, dealing 80% of Basic Attack damage (up to 2 Follow-ups per turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally acts, has a 20% chance to launch a Follow-up against the enemy with the lowest HP, dealing 100% of Basic Attack damage (up to 2 Follow-ups per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally acts, has a 20% chance to launch a Follow-up against the enemy with the lowest HP, dealing 110% of Basic Attack damage (up to 2 Follow-ups per turn).
